metadata.title: New disclosure: Trump owns SpaceX, Disney shares — and is reaping profits from oil & gas stocks

content.text:
President Trump made over 1,000 new stock trades in June, totaling between $78 million and $263 million.
Yahoo Finance Washington Correspondent Ben Werschkul outlines the details in the video above.
financial disclosure found which the president um released for June just showed a continued high level of of stock trading that we've seen all throughout 2026, um at levels that that have frankly taken a lot of people back. The the latest report here as you can see, 34 pages long and runs pages after pages of stock trading.
Here's some highlights for folks. Um, as as everyone who watches Yahoo Finance knows, this covers June and that's also the month that SpaceX went public. So the president did invest a little bit in SpaceX between $15 and $50,000. These disclosures are based on ranges, so it's somewhere in that. Um, President Trump joined other lawmakers in Washington who have invested in the IPO in the weeks after it happened in mid-June.
President also made investments in Tesla, that's evidence of his of his alliance with with Elon Musk, but it's also an evidence of his investments in Big Tech. That's been a theme throughout this year. Apple, Amazon, other companies like that are also in the disclosure. Lots of other, lots of other interesting tidbits in here to note.
Brooke, I know you cover Disney a lot. President Trump even um go um invest in companies that he criticized in the past. Disney's in here as well.
Palantir is another one that's that's that's gotten a lot of attention. President Trump was buying, or his accounts at least were buying um Palantir stock in mid-June, which is the same time that he was announcing a peace deal with Iran, which is notable here. Worth noting that the President's team, these these accounts are under the president's name, so it's the president's money, but they're managed by the Trump Organization.
and the Trump Organization says that it's there's another layer of protection that it's a third party that that makes the investment decisions without the president or his family's involvement.
There was also new research into the president's profits from these transactions. What did it find?
Yeah, so this is a new um report from the from from democratic lawmakers on the Congress's Joint Economic Committee. They zeroed in on oil and gas stocks.
What they did is they looked at the President's portfolio, or what we know about the president's portfolio at the end of 2025, when they found that he had about $45.6 million in oil and gas stocks at on December 31st of last year. The the value of those assets um has risen up to up to about $61 million.
These are ranges, so these are the upper ranges, so it's up to these numbers. But that's a $15 million in potential profits that the President makes and sort of underscores the political vulnerability that's here. This is this is money that comes, this these are stocks that have risen because of high gas prices. They've helped some energy stocks, but there are clear pain points for voters and I think shows the political salience here even as Trump himself has been slowing down his trading.
You're going to hear a lot more about this issue, this stock trading, this presidential stock trading between now and November. Democrats clearly think this is an opportunity for them and and they're pushing it hard. We saw 3,700 trades from the president in the first quarter, a thousand trades in June, so he's not slowing or his accounts aren't slowing down at least, um even even with this political pressure.
